scope: Engineering browser/API/local MongoDB E2E; no model, Atlas or LangGraph execution
checks: Health distinguishes an unconfigured model adapter from the unimplemented scientific workflow
Browser created labeled fixture in real MongoDB
All graph nodes fit within the canvas at 1440×900
Modal traps keyboard focus, Escape restores its opener, and graph claims open with Enter
Source withdrawal: A loses sole support; B retains S2; C unchanged; old evidence inspectable
Accepted operation retry deduplicates; changed payload under same ID rejects
Browser replay restores initial support and disables writes; return to live restores withdrawn state
Downloaded dossier independently matches current snapshot without article text
Actual API process SIGKILL/restart retains accepted state and browser reconnects (not workflow recovery)
Actual browser reducer replays persisted log exactly, recovers missing events and deduplicates deliveries
Restoring source availability requires review and does not automatically recertify A
Browser imports two real pinned source records without fabricated claims
Pinned lookup resolves gene/term identity and all returned candidate IDs, preserves alias/taxon ambiguity, and leaves obsolete terms and non-exact synonyms unaccepted
Real paper search → canonical span read → browser pin → MongoDB evidence → exact quote/hash reconstruction
Fresh API process accepts canonical span retry without duplicate evidence and browser reopens pinned evidence
Changed source version and forged span rejected; invalid request fields are not echoed
